result.title: VLX-Go: Robust Embodied Tracking through Multi-Stage Learning and On-Policy Refinement
result.summary: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present \method{}, a vision--language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54\% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80\%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22\%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 VLX-Go，一个用于具身视觉追踪的视觉-语言 waypoint 策略，聚焦在有干扰者时跟随指定人物；方法上组合冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时序上下文与 transformer 主干，训练依次经过视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理中期训练和追踪专化，并初步尝试用过滤后的 oracle 标签对策略访问状态做 on-policy refinement。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先做视觉-语言对齐、再做任务专化」的多阶段配方及基于过滤 oracle 标签的 on-policy 细化，可能为 LVR 中视觉信息保留、轨迹监督与贡献分配提供可核查线索；干扰者场景的目标辨别也与视觉证据筛选相关，但论文并不研究推理期 latent 状态的生成与使用，需阅读正文确认迁移价值。
